text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh~n♪ Ping-pong, arcade games, pillow 
fights~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To think we get to stay at such a 
luxurious inn! All hail the lottery!

One day, after things had settled down, I 
went to a hot spring inn with Biko 
Pegasus. We used the hot spring trip 
ticket I had won in the New Year's 
lottery.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I manage to become a splendid hero— 
let's go to the hot springs together when 
that time comes!

"...In order to fulfill the promise I made 
with her back then."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, check it out! Looks like this inn has 
a karaoke corner!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if they have Carrotman songs 
too. Let's sing together later, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaahhh!? It's Biko Pegasus! Whoa, it's 
really her, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I've watched all of your races! The 
part where you shout your special move is 
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: (Waah...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Could it be, are you all my fans!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks for all the support, 
everyone! Come shake my hand at the hot 
spring inn!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Sing Biko's song for me! I 
always sing along with you in front of the 
TV!

text_block_list.name: Mother A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Don't make such unreasonable 
demands! Biko-san is supposed to be 
resting...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! I can't just ignore 
voices calling for a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right, Trainer! Can I go spread a little 
cheer to everyone for a bit!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Single-strike soul infusion☆ Pegasus 
Punch~♪ ...Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Children
text_block_list.text: I've got your back! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone's power is becoming one! 
Okay, next up is "Instinctive Speed"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We sang so much! Everyone was smiling 
too—it was the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, check it out! This shopping street has 
tons of souvenirs... apparently!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a contest to see who can buy 
the cooler stuff, Trainer! Wonder what I 
should get...

text_block_list.name: Auntie A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Are you Biko-chan by any chance!? 
My grandchild just loves you to pieces~!

text_block_list.name: Mister A
text_block_list.text:
How about trying the shooting gallery if 
you'd like! We're holding a tournament for 
tourists right now, so come have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? All right, let me show you what 
a hero can do!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer! We can get souvenirs later, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Can't believe we actually won! Everyone 
was so happy, I'm glad I went!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, relaxing with Trainer might not be 
so bad after all... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look at this sign! It says there's a 
limestone cave over there! Trainer, let's 
go explore—

text_block_list.name: Young Man A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Biko Pegasus-san?! Um, I watch your 
races! Even though you're small, I love 
watching you sprint with all your 
might...!

text_block_list.name: Young Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"We're having a barbecue over there... 
Please, come have some!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh, of course! Meat, huh? I can't 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer. ......

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, never mind after all! All right, I'm 
gonna eat until I'm stuffed~!

"And so, Biko Pegasus continued to do fan 
service until sundown."
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I sure did a lot of things today. 
...*yawn*...
choice_data_list:
Looks like playing tired you out, so shall 
we get some sleep soon?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! N-No, this won't do! I'm not satisfied 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Because, today is... Uuu~~, 
today is~~~...!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to be everyone's hero! All your 
cheering fills me with power!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Still, being with everyone, for some 
reason today...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even though my Trainer is supposed to be 
right next to me... It feels as though 
they're so far away."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "So please! Just a little bit is fine!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Make memories together with me!
choice_data_list: Got it, let's have as much fun as we want!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: !! Yay~~~~~! Thanks a bunch, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then hey hey, I want that one! A Carrot 
Man roleplay pillow fight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna develop a special finishing 
move with this pillow-fighting pillow! 
It'll be the ultimate technique for you 
and me!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, partner! Let's pour your energy 
and mine into this pillow!
choice_data_list: I entrust my power to you!
I'm entrusting my strength to you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh! I love that! Sounds super cool! 
Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Pegasus Twin Pillow Cannon"!! ...Ahaha, 
how do you like that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
choice_data_list: Shall we go to sleep soon?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?! N-No, just now... I was merely 
meditating!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is no problem at all! 
So...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll stick around just a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We'll be together forever, right! 
...Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*, *snooze*...

—Tired out from playing, Biko Pegasus 
falls asleep, and I gently carry her back 
to her room.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and Biko 
Pegasus...
